headline: EPS rises sharply sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: PT Jasa Marga (Persero) reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of Rp156, up 45.8% q/q from Rp107 and up 20.0% y/y from Rp130.02.
summary_long: EPS of Rp156 rose 45.8% sequentially from Rp107 and 20.0% year-over-year from Rp130.02. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
